card.name: Old chemistry texts on atoms
card.fires_on: Words and spaces inside 18th–19th century chemistry prose about atoms, affinity and combinations of gases, such as Dalton-era descriptions. Fires on small words like of, the, and a space before a number in atom-composition lists.
